category: hosted feature flags, experimentation and observability

free_tier.stated: Developer: USD 0 a month forever, no credit card; unlimited feature flags and seats, 5 service connections and 1K client-side MAU a month, 100K experimentation MAU, 10M logs and 10M traces, 5K session replays and 5K errors, 5K AI runs a month; 1 project and 3 environments
free_tier.notes: The allowance is counted in service connections (one server-side SDK connected to one environment for a month), client-side MAU (each unique client-side user or device), log lines, trace spans, session replays, errors and AI runs; no single unit term fits. Sign-up starts a 14-day trial with Enterprise features that converts to Developer. When usage keeps exceeding the Developer entitlements the plan converts to read-only mode.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no flag or payload size limit is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: Logs, traces, session replays and errors are stored one month; AgentControl run and eval data stays 14 days

egress.terms: not applicable: flag evaluations reach the SDKs over routes that are never rate limited; no traffic allowance is published

interface_detail: REST API at https://app.launchdarkly.com/api/v2 with personal or service access tokens (a GET /api/v2/projects without a token answered 401); SDK keys, mobile keys and client-side IDs cannot call the REST API; an OpenAPI specification is published.
tooling: 30 SDKs (13 client-side, 13 server-side, 4 edge), the Relay Proxy, or any HTTP client against the REST API with an access token.
chaining: Feature flags for a few server-side services on free compute, with client-side flags for up to 1K MAU a month.

limits.value: 5 service connections and 1K client-side MAU a month
10M logs and 10M traces a month; 5K session replays and 5K errors a month; 5K AI runs a month
usage that keeps exceeding the Developer entitlements converts the plan to read-only mode
logs, traces, session replays and errors stored one month; AgentControl data 14 days

limits_note: 1 project and 3 environments on Developer. REST API rate limits are not published; LaunchDarkly returns them in response headers.
binding_note: Each server-side SDK in each environment uses one of the 5 service connections a month, so server-side use meets that count first; client-side apps meet 1K MAU. Continued excess turns the plan read-only.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for first name, last name, email and password, or a GitHub sign-in, and states no credit card is required; it starts a 14-day trial that continues on the free Developer plan.

reliability_note: Usage above the Developer entitlements is warned and then turns the plan read-only; Developer support is the Discord community.
confidence_note: Every value is quoted from the first-party pricing page, plan and billing docs, REST API overview and sign-up page; the REST API host was probed and answered 401 without a token. A flag evaluation through an SDK key on a Developer account would move it to measured.
